about: Bars of a measured grid, shows/scenes/deadmau5 - Raise Your Weapon.beats. This song really changes speed: 112 bars at 128.000 BPM, then a 16-bar accelerando, linear in beats, from 128 to 140, then 140.000 BPM to the end; the format can only delay a beat, so 140 is the line and every earlier beat carries a hold. Bar 0 is at 0.026 s, the drop is bar 130 at 242.14 s, kick on 1, snare on 3. Eight minutes in two worlds. A single candle in the dark while the moon crosses from ear to ear; the singer is a pale light that rises through the helmet with each phrase and brightens the flame as it passes. At the kick an army marches along the jaw and the ears are shields being struck. As the top end returns a blade is drawn: one thin line grows across the brow over sixteen bars. Then the bass leaves and the tempo climbs, the shields ticking faster with it, and the title crosses once, in the quiet. The drop is crimson and white-hot steel: one slash across the shell on every snare, left then right, and the far ear flares as the blade lands on it. Banners unfurl, the blade swings overhead in arcs, crossed swords stand on the dome. The singer comes back as a flame in the middle of the war, and on each long note a single sword is raised from the jaw. At the crash it all falls, the candle is lit again, the moon crosses again and the blade slides back into its scabbard before the flame gutters out.
